tools.name: get_adtech_intel
tools.description: Today's AdTech news briefing from DigiAdapt, refreshed daily at 06:00 UTC from public sources. Each item has a headline, a two-sentence summary, the source, date and link. Optionally filter to one part of the ecosystem: dsp, ssp, ctv (streaming publishers) or oem (TV makers).

tools.name: search_intel
tools.description: Search past DigiAdapt briefings (up to a year) for a company, product or keyword, e.g. "PubMatic", "Netflix ads", "identity". Every word must appear in the headline, summary or source. Leave query empty to list everything in the period.

tools.name: get_market_signal
tools.description: The DigiAdapt Signal: a two-sentence read on what today's AdTech developments have in common.

tools.name: get_digiadapt_expertise
tools.description: Who DigiAdapt is, the advisory services it offers, relevant articles by its founder Swaminathan Iyer, and how to get in touch. Pass a topic (e.g. "CTV monetisation in APAC", "SSP selection") to get the matching services.
